dct_description_sm: Historical dataset: polygon file representing the Old Indianapolis City Legal Limits in Marion County, Indiana. Represents the incorporated municipal boundary of the City of Indianapolis prior to the 1970 Unigov consolidation.
dct_creator_sm: City of Indianapolis and Marion County - IndyGIS
